full_page.content:
Page 16 Cont.
Jan. 7 Feb. 25 Robert Hamilton here to-day 100% well - save healing scars on side of head. Deo Gr!
Wm. D. Bruce - 14 - of Jackson, Mich. - to be examined in Ann Arbor - physically and mentally ... . has not been acting normally.
Pvt. Anthony Juliano - 23 - practicing setting mines, one exploded killed three of his associates and took his sight - there is hope to save one eye ....
Golden Rosary found - Mrs. Eva Dertingger.
Page 17
Jan. 9 Robert Wagner - 32 - nervous break feared - has wife and two small children - brother chaplain - Capt. Wag.
10 Edwina (Mrs. Berg - 50 - presbiterian = internal cancer - in Harper Hos. Expecting operation tomorrow. Husband Enrolled her this a.m. 5.
10 Alphonse Malenfant - 57 - for 14 yrs. unable to work with "creeping paralysis; his oldest boy 18 is on way "over seas" - has wife and six other children praying for his recovery.
11 Anthony Pittiglio - 7 - paralitic since birth - seems intelligent of docil disposition but has no controll of limbs or muscels. Enrolled. to-nite 1.00
12 Elsie Miller - 32 - mother of four little children, on way to Grace Hospital for goitre operation. Enrolls in Ser. Masses .... 3.00 ...
Sharon Neumann - 3'2 - invalid since birth - beautiful little child but sadly helpless - deaf, dumb, blind.
Page 18 Jan. 12 Miss Frances McGee - 38 - in Carmel Hospital with acute lukemia - a- nointed this a.m. at 3 o'clock.
Poor S.
Ward Taylor - 60 - baptist in Deaconess Hospital; had serious nerve- break and complete collapse.
